name: Kirinskoye Field-BTK Nogliki Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: scope: operating field gathering/export flowline (unprocessed gas-condensate-water mixture, subsea production system to onshore processing complex), not transmission; no roster match (checked P0758, P1783, P2027, P3894, P3895)
researcher_notes: neftegaz.ru (verified, names pipeline, states value): field-to-UKPG/BTK line 43.2 km total, 28.7 km subsea; carries raw mixture of gas, condensate and water from the Kirinskoye subsea production complex (Gazprom Dobycha Shelf Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, Sakhalin-3) to the Nogliki onshore processing complex (BTK); first gas Oct 2013, commercial 2014, i.e. operating for ~12 years, not a new announcement (2026 article is about pipe-laying of NEW onshore collectors for the South-Kirinskoye expansion, a worker death). Sponsor and endpoints identified but it is field gathering, not transmission; also a 29.3 km MEG line exists. Single source, tier medium. Downstream commercial gas pipeline BTK-GKS Sakhalin is ~139 km (same article) and feeds Sakhalin-Khabarovsk-Vladivostok (P0758); that 139 km line and the new South-Kirinskoye gas collector/gas pipeline to GKS Sakhalin may be separate discovery candidates (not vetted here; check whether covered by P0758 before adding). If Baird rules field export lines to shore are in scope (cf. P1783 TransSakhalin starts at a field), this could be promoted: Status operating, StartLocation Kirinskoye field, EndLocation BTK Nogliki, LengthKnown 43.2 km, Owner Gazprom, ProposalYear/StartYear 2013, ref as above.
